subject: Request: Satellite Program trial credit top-up and extension
messages:
From: Anna Patel <anna@foundrylabs.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-27T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: Pilot credit top-up & short extension for Satellite Program

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for getting Foundry Labs into the Satellite program — the team is excited. We hit an unexpected blocker: our enterprise pilot customer pushed our in-person demo out two weeks due to procurement scheduling. That means our usage window will shift and we won’t be able to hit the original milestone cadence.

We’re asking if Redwood can do a one-time trial credit top-up (additional $10,000 in hosted credits) and extend our pilot period by two weeks so we don’t get shut off mid-demo. The customer is on a tight timeline and this demo is make-or-break for expansion.

I’ve attached a short usage note (pilot-usage-forecast.xlsx) and a 90-second video of the MVP demo to show progress.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call this afternoon if that helps.

—Anna
Anna Patel
Head of Partnerships, Foundry Labs
anna@foundrylabs.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Patel <anna@foundrylabs.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot credit top-up & short extension for Satellite Program

Anna — thanks for the context and the attachments. I’m sorry to hear about the scheduling slip; we’ve seen similar timing shifts in a few pilots recently.

I’ll escalate this to our credits/finance team and loop in Sales Lead Rishi for oversight. Two quick asks from our side to speed approval:
1) Can you attach an explicit milestone update (one-paragraph) that describes what the extended 2-week window will allow you to complete and the expected customer outcome?
2) Confirm the exact dollar amount you want Redwood to apply as top-up (you mentioned ~$10k).

If you can get those over by EOD I’ll push for a fast decision and share a conditional approval template.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-28T10:20:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Request: Pilot credit top-up & short extension for Satellite Program

Team — forwarding Foundry’s ask. Key points:
- External asked for $10k additional hosted credits and +2 week extension (demo moved).
- They attached a usage forecast and a short demo video.
- Customer demo is the primary gating event for expansion (we’d like to keep them healthy).

Recommendation: consider a conditional top-up (smaller immediate credit + milestone release) rather than the full amount up front. If possible, can finance approve an initial $6k top-up with the remaining $4k released after the demo if they provide a signed SOW amendment or a short post-demo usage report?

I’m happy to draft the conditional approval email and the SOW template (see link).

Thanks,
Tessa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-29T14:58:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Pilot credit top-up & short extension for Satellite Program

Tessa, Rishi — I’m okay with a staged approach on a one-off basis. Conditions I want captured:
- Immediate one-time top-up: $6,000 in hosted credits (applied to the Satellite pilot allocation).
- Extension: 10 calendar days (not 14) to keep calendar impact lower — we can be flexible here but prefer fixed window.
- Release of remaining $4,000 contingent on receipt of either: signed SOW amendment (DocuSign link) OR a post-demo usage & outcomes report within 72 hours of the demo.
- Require a short usage forecast and a single point of contact from Foundry for billing reconciliation (name + email).

I’ve attached a redlined SOW draft (SOW-draft.pdf) and added the wording to the DocuSign template. If Rishi + Tessa approve, we can send the conditional approval to the customer by EOD Friday.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Patel <anna@foundrylabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:44:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot credit top-up & short extension for Satellite Program

Hi Anna — good news. We can support Foundry with a conditional, one-time exception to the standard pilot cadence:

1) Immediate: $6,000 hosted credit top-up applied to your Satellite pilot allocation.
2) Extension: 10 calendar days from your current pilot end date (we can start the extension on the date you confirm).
3) Remaining $4,000: will be released after you provide EITHER a signed SOW amendment via DocuSign (link below) OR a short post-demo outcomes report within 72 hours of the demo.

What we need from you to finalize today:
- Updated one-paragraph milestone description (what you’ll complete in the extra window).
- Billing contact name + email for reconciliation.
- If you prefer the full $10k up front, we can discuss but will likely require executive approval and a brief commercial note.

DocuSign SOW: https://app.docusign.com/link/FL-SOW-2026
Shared SOW draft: https://share.redwood.ai/s/Foundry-SOW-draft

If that works, reply with the milestone paragraph and billing contact and we’ll apply the $6k immediately. Thanks — root for your demo!

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf (attached for redlines), pilot-usage-forecast.xlsx (from Foundry), MVP-demo.mp4 (referenced)
